description: Screen a wallet address before you transact with it: sanctions check against the OFAC SDN digital-currency address list and UN consolidated list (refreshed daily, matched locally), plus free on-chain signals on Base — contract vs EOA, verification status, activity, balance, malicious public tags. Returns a 0-100 risk score with named flags. Built for x402 agents screening counterparties. Pay-per-call via x402 (USDC, Base).

_payment.description: Optional base64 x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE payload. Omit to receive payment requirements.

address.description: Wallet address to screen. EVM addresses (0x + 40 hex) get full on-chain signals; any chain's address format is checked against the sanctions lists.

name: agentbit.wallet_screen
title: Wallet Screening
